findings.title: Rewritten migration drops the original column on a populated table, losing its data
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The rewrite emits DROP COLUMN with only a commented-out UPDATE, and the wizard's migrate prompt defaults to yes, so populated columns are silently lost.

findings.title: Type-string change makes drizzle-kit regenerate ALTERs for already-encrypted columns, which the rewriter turns into DROPs of ciphertext
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Same speculative snapshot-diff-to-DROP chain; it assumes drizzle-kit emits the exact qualified form the regex matches, which the cited code does not show.

findings.title: Shipped stash-cli skill and stack README still instruct the removed `db setup` command
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The removed db setup command is still documented in the shipped skill (which the wizard copies into user repos) and in the stack README.

findings.title: Auto-detection without opt-out picks the wrong install mode
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Detection has no opt-out because parseArgs only sets flags to true, and Supabase detection only matches host suffixes, whereas the removed setup asked the user explicitly.

findings.title: New .env precedence silently retargets DATABASE_URL for db install/push and migrations
findings.label: valid
findings.note: stash.ts now loads .env.local etc. before .env and dotenv does not overwrite, so DATABASE_URL can resolve differently than at base, where only config() ran.
